expected.canonical_headline: Martin County Sheriff's Office investigates body found in Hutchinson Island mangroves
selected_headlines: Martin County authorities confirm body found in mangroves is missing Oklahoma visitor
source_headlines: Body found in Martin County mangroves confirmed as missing man - cbs12.com
novel_facts: Body confirmed as Michael Anthony Debevec (positive identification)
Medical Examiner has not yet determined cause of death
No apparent signs of foul play found
Backpack found hanging high in tree with computer inside
Phone records showed movement between Chastain Beach and House of Refuge Friday morning
Debevec traveled from Port St. Lucie area to Martin County at about 3 a.m. on Aug. 27
Family has been notified of his death
